drhp.business: Pavna Industries Limited, formerly Pavna Locks Limited, manufactures a wide range of automotive parts — ignition switches, fuel tank caps, latches, auto locks, switches, oil pumps, throttle bodies, fuel cocks and casting components — for reputed OEMs across passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, heavy and light commercial vehicles, and off-road vehicles. It serves both domestic and export markets and supplies customers including Bajaj, Kawasaki, Honda, TVS, Mahindra, Escorts, Royal Enfield, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra Wheels, Eicher Motors, Tork Motors, Revolt and Mahindra Electric.

drhp.expansion: Pavna is constructing a new plant at Hosur; construction has commenced and the facility is expected to be completed and operational in Q3 FY2026-27, to further enhance manufacturing capabilities and cater to future customer requirements. The Company has also developed a small setup in Pantnagar and moved warehousing operations from rented premises to its own premises. It established an R&D Centre in Noida to explore opportunities in automotive electronics, and entered a Joint Venture with SMC Microchip (Taiwan) focused on future technologies in electronic locks.
